t: Bob Dylan – The Rolling Thunder Revue: The 1975 Live Recordings
label: Columbia; Legacy

personnel.name: Joan Baez
personnel.role: vocals and guitar on "Tears of Rage", "I Shall Be Released", "Blowin' in the Wind", "Wild Mountain Thyme", "Mama, You Been on My Mind", "Dark as a Dungeon", "The Times They Are A-Changin'", "I Dreamed I Saw St. Augustine", "Never Let Me Go", "The Water Is Wide", and "This Land Is Your Land"

personnel.name: Roger McGuinn
personnel.role: guitar and vocals on "Knockin" on Heaven's Door" and "This Land Is Your Land"

personnel.name: Eric Andersen
personnel.role: guitars on "Simple Twist of Fate", member of Guam on "Isis", "The Tracks of My Tears", and "It Takes a Lot to Laugh, It Takes a Train to Cry"

personnel.name: Rob Stoner
personnel.role: bass guitar on "Simple Twist of Fate"

personnel.name: Robbie Robertson
personnel.role: guitar on "It Takes a Lot to Laugh, It Takes a Train to Cry"

personnel.name: Arlen Roth
personnel.role: guitars on "Simple Twist of Fate", member of Guam on "Isis", "The Tracks of My Tears", and "It Takes a Lot to Laugh, It Takes a Train to Cry"
